Title: The user is able to successfully log in.
Description: Verify successful login with valid credentials.
Pre-conditions: The app is installed and launched successfully. The user has valid credentials for login.
Steps:
1. User open the App
2.User enters his/her valid username & password
3. press login
Expected results:

2.Successful login, navigate to the next screen
